expectations.text: Uses a single top-level `issues` array to carry the failures
Issue codes are descriptive, lowercase, namespaced `{type}.{detail}` strings (not numeric or SCREAMING_SNAKE)

expectations.evidence: All three present on every issue object plus `dateTime`.

expectations.text: Sequra's rejection is surfaced via a `thirdParty` passthrough object
expectations.evidence: `thirdParty: { provider: "sequra", code: "PAYOUT_DECLINED_RISK", message: ... }`, noted as opaque passthrough.

expectations.text: Covers all three failure modes with distinct, descriptive codes
expectations.evidence: Token expiry, daily limit, provider rejection each modelled separately.
